dockerfile.description: 16 of the 18 Dockerfiles here are named ToolDockerfile or BaseDockerfile. Renovate's default patterns only match a basename that starts with Dockerfile or has it after a dot, so without this it would see 2 of 18. managerFilePatterns merges with the defaults rather than replacing them.

docker-compose.description: Every image in the compose files is :local or :latest - nothing for Renovate to update.

packageRules.description: Student course scaffolding baked into the language images as project templates, not real dependencies of this repo.
These pins come with SHA-256 ARGs that Renovate cannot bump.
prBodyNotes: Update the matching `*_SHA256` ARGs in the same Dockerfile by hand, or the build fails. Rustup: the `.sha256` next to each `rustup-init` on static.rust-lang.org. Bazelisk: `sha256sum` of each `bazelisk-linux-<arch>` release asset. Go: https://go.dev/dl/.

packageRules.description: Node stays on 22 in the images; @types/node must match it.

customManagers.description: Scorpio is pinned by a full Open VSX URL in the base image's plugin list, which no built-in manager reads. Its GitHub release tags (v2.2.0) match its Open VSX versions (2.2.0), and the version appears twice in the URL.

Tool versions pinned as ARG NAME_VERSION in a ToolDockerfile, annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above. The shared preset only matches files named Dockerfile, so it misses ours.
